purpose: Large Arabic and multilingual source collections for natural-language coverage, instruction tuning, reasoning, and teacher-output distillation.

subsets.role: Arabic source text corpus; suitable as raw pretraining text after cleaning and document filtering
Arabic context passages with question-answer pairs; teacher-like QA output paired with source text
Arabic conversational supervised examples; assistant messages include final responses and optional separate reasoning fields
Arabic style-rewrite data; treat as transformed/synthetic rather than raw natural text

sources.notes: Very strong Arabic-first candidate. Do not mix raw corpus text directly into supervised prompt/target files. The importer excludes separate think/think_faster fields and exports only visible prompt/answer content. Important: the Jais-3 collection description reports a mixed-origin corpus, including synthetic or machine-translated data and substantial dialect content. Do not classify every row as naturally human-authored; preserve subset-level provenance and audit origin first. Importer marks raw records as corpus_candidate pending origin, duplication, and quality review.

sources.reported_scale: 33.1M rows / 96.1 GB; dataset title and card report 101B Arabic words

subsets.role: large raw Arabic text corpus for language exposure and pretraining

sources.notes: Large volume, but perform language-quality checks, deduplication, contamination screening, and document-level filtering before use. Importer marks raw records as corpus_candidate pending origin, duplication, and quality review.

sources.reported_scale: 743,288 articles / about 244M words; published card and file-viewer size figures differ, so verify actual download size
sources.notes: Good smaller corpus to inspect first before pulling multi-tens-of-GB sources. The raw articles are corpus candidates, not automatically verified as fully human-authored or unique. Importer marks raw records as corpus_candidate pending origin, duplication, and quality review.

sources.reported_scale: 204K human-annotated prompt-completion pairs overall; 202.4K train rows in the default configuration

sources.reported_scale: 513M instances across all languages; Arabic configs include MSA and multiple regional dialects, with several million rows per large config
sources.notes: This is a mixed collection of translated, templated, and task-specific examples, not a uniformly organic conversational corpus. Preserve config and task metadata; inspect each subset before promoting it to natural_sft.

subsets.role: Arabic user/assistant conversations derived from OpenHermes

sources.notes: Teacher/distillation-style data, not organic human conversation. The dataset includes user and GPT response fields.
